facts.statement: Zhanjilepis aspartilis is an extinct member of the yunnanolepid group of placoderms.
facts.quote: Zhanjilepis aspartilis is an extinct yunnanolepid placoderm

facts.statement: The genus Zhanjilepis is known exclusively from distinctively ordered plates.
facts.quote: Zhanjilepis is known only from distinctively ordered plates

facts.statement: The plates of Zhanjilepis are very similar to those of the Late Llandovery yunnanolepid Shimenolepis.
facts.quote: Zhanjilepis plates are very similar to the Late Llandovery yunnanolepid Shimenolepis

facts.statement: Fossils of Zhanjilepis aspartilis have been found in Pridoli and Lochkovian rocks in Hunan, China.
facts.quote: from Pridoli and Lochkovian rocks of Hunan, China

facts.statement: Zhanjilepis belongs to the parent group Antiarchi.
Zhanjilepis is classified in the class Placodermi.
Zhanjilepis lived during the Lochkovian stage, between 419.62 and 413.02 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Lochkovian to Lochkovian (419.62 to 413.02 million years ago)
